# Site stats (community, Node only)

A plugin whose interface is the command line: `hax site-stats` (`--public`, `--top`) prints the number of pages, words and kinds of block, with the most used blocks. The same operation is offered to agents through MCP (`x-hax-mcp`).

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| operation | `siteStatsReport` | `GET /x/api/v1/plugins/<id>/report` (bearerAuth) | Counts the site's pages, words and web component blocks, and lists the most used block tags. |
| CLI command | `hax site-stats report (hax site-stats)` |  | Pages, words and blocks in this site |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
